eval_map_compute_mAP: evaluate mean average precision of object detection results against ground truth annotations for a dataset
average_precision_calculate_AP: calculate average precision from recall and precision arrays using area or 11points mode
tpfp_default_classify_detections: classify detected bounding boxes as true positive or false positive using a fixed IoU threshold
tpfp_openimages_handle_group_of: classify detections as TP or FP for OpenImages evaluation supporting group-of bounding boxes with IoA threshold
print_map_summary_display_results: print a summary table of mAP results showing gts, dets, recall, and AP per class
